name: Kinetics motion library OG card by kinetics.colorion.co
description: A 1200×630 near-black social card organised into three horizontal bands: a small top-left lockup (orange dot plus bold monospace wordmark), an oversized two-line display headline in extra-bold type where only the final word "weight." flips to orange, and a damped spring curve that enters at full amplitude behind the headline and decays to a settled flat hairline ending in a solid orange dot. A monospace keyword strip in muted gray with middot separators anchors the bottom margin. Colour is restricted to off-white, orange and gray on black, and the pairing of a heavy humanist display face with monospace secondary text gives the whole card a precise, engineering-flavoured tone — the curve literally demonstrates the product's pitch.
